name: stack
description: Library and framework references with the gotchas a model gets wrong. GreenSock's official GSAP set (core, timeline, ScrollTrigger, plugins, utils, React, Vue/Svelte); a motion/react token-and-pattern system in three layers; Remotion's rules for programmatic video; Vercel's React and Next.js performance rules and the React docs' discipline for when not to use an Effect; shadcn/ui's official skill with project context from its CLI; Supabase's Postgres performance and RLS rules, opinionated PostgreSQL table design, Prisma traps, and zero-downtime migrations; the C++ Core Guidelines by section, Boost.Asio with version floors, and Swift 6.2 strict concurrency; .NET backend patterns and saga orchestration. Contains third-party skills under their own licenses — see NOTICE.md.
